description: Implemented Java services for order processing, payment-state reconciliation and inventory reservations.
Reduced p95 API latency from 420 ms to 240 ms in staging through query plans, indexing and bounded caching.
Added idempotency keys and transactional outbox processing; tested retries and duplicate event delivery.
Coordinated a three-engineer migration and wrote runbooks for rollback, alerts and incident response.
Designed explicit order-state transitions and rejected invalid updates before database writes.
Introduced bounded connection pools and measured behavior under sustained load and downstream timeouts.
Reviewed schema changes for compatibility with older service versions during rolling deployment.
Investigated two staging incidents involving retry storms; added limits and dashboards for queue growth.
Built REST endpoints and integration tests for a small business scheduling application.
Added structured logging and documented error handling for client integrations.
Worked with a product manager to translate scheduling rules into API acceptance criteria.
Used database fixtures to test timezone boundaries, conflicting reservations and cancellation races.
Presented a handover demo and documented setup instructions for the next intern.

projects.name: Reliable Task Queue
description: Implemented worker leases, exponential backoff and dead-letter queues with documented delivery semantics.
Benchmarked 1,500 jobs per second on a four-worker local setup; included hardware and payload details.
Implemented graceful worker shutdown and tested lease expiry after forced process termination.
Compared throughput and tail latency across different payload sizes and worker counts.
Documented the absence of exactly-once execution and recommended idempotent job handlers.

projects.name: Database Migration Guard
description: Built checks for migration ordering, destructive changes and backward compatibility in CI.
Validated migration history against a clean database and a snapshot representing the previous release.
Added a review checklist for long-running locks, backfills and rollback feasibility.
Produced machine-readable CI summaries to help reviewers identify risky statements.

projects.name: Service Load and Failure Harness
description: Created repeatable traffic scenarios with burst loads, downstream delays and partial dependency failures.
Recorded throughput, p95 latency, error rate and resource utilization under each scenario.
Implemented warm-up periods and reproducible configuration files for fair before/after comparisons.
Documented benchmark limits and avoided presenting local test throughput as production capacity.

projects.name: Order State Simulation Sandbox
description: Created a sandbox that replays order events under delayed, duplicated and out-of-order delivery.
Defined invariant checks for reservation counts, cancellation states and reconciliation records.
Compared compensating actions with database transactions in isolated failure scenarios.
Added deterministic seeds and replayable event traces to reproduce failed tests.
Documented which assumptions depended on external payment systems and could not be verified locally.

projects.name: Incident Review Knowledge Base
description: Built searchable summaries of synthetic incidents for practicing operational analysis.
Structured records around trigger, detection, customer impact, mitigation and preventive follow-up.
Added consistency checks for timestamps and links to runbook sections.
Led two fictional team exercises comparing escalation decisions during simulated service failures.
Published a contributor guide emphasizing reproducible evidence and blameless incident descriptions.

awards.name: Harbor Engineering Quality Award
awards.description: Recognized incident reduction and migration documentation.

awards.name: Internal Reliability Improvement Recognition
awards.description: Recognized documented failure testing and operational handover.
